newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SMALL BOMB EXPLODES NEAR HUNGARY SYNAGOGUE - POLICE.
newsitem.headline: SMALL BOMB EXPLODES NEAR HUNGARY SYNAGOGUE - POLICE.

text.p: A homemade bomb exploded near Budapest's main synagogue, scattering debris up to 20 m but causing no injuries, police said on Thursday.
Police said the bomb exploded at about 8 p.m. on Wednesday, ripping apart a dustbin in front of a house about 200 m from the Dohanyi Utca synagogue.
Police said there was no indication that the blast had been intended to damage the synagogue, which is Europe's largest and was recently reopened after a complete refurbishment.
